name: Western Road rear-yard footprint
summary: The small mapped square sits beside a parking space in a treed service yard. The current orthophoto shows brown ground and an enclosure with no identifiable roof.

evidence.note: The 2025 orthophoto shows branches, brown ground, and the edge of an enclosure next to a car. Unlike the nearby square shed to the north, no continuous roof plane or roof-edge shadow appears at this footprint.
Inventory P50 / P90 / maximum: 5.1 / 7.96 / 8.66 m above local ground.

notes: This footprint is omitted from the visible building set. The adjacent tree and yard fencing may account for the municipal outline or elevated lidar returns.
lidarNote: The 5.1 m median and 8.66 m maximum coincide with tree branches. The footprint has no identifiable roof plane.
